variants.headline: Fire consumes {{city}} as {{civilization}} razes it
body: {{city}} is burning at the order of {{civilization}}. In {{turns}}, the last of its walls will come down. Travelers on the approach road report smoke lying across the fields, and the work of destruction continues.

variants.headline: {{population}} remain in {{city}} as the flames spread
body: Smoke from {{city}} shows from the ridge road. {{civilization}} is razing the city around {{population}} people who are still in it. Officers at the gate say the burning will take {{turns}} more and that the roads out stay passable for now. With hopes that this tragic situation may soon come to an end, many families still refuse to leave,

variants.headline: A City Consumed
body: We are credibly informed that {{civilization}} has commenced the razing of {{city}}. Our correspondents report that the city, located {{distance}} away, will be entirely erased in {{turns}}. It remains to be seen how this vacancy shall alter the balance of the region.

variants.headline: The Passing of {{city}}
body: {{city}} was once the crowning jewel of {{civilization}}, a sanctuary of high spires and deep faith. Now, it faces its final trial. In {{turns}}, the flames will consume the last altar. We pray that the souls of the {{population}} residents find a mercy their city could not secure.

variants.headline: Defenses weakened at {{city}}
body: The walls of {{city}} are badly damaged following recent assaults. Military observers note a visible decline in structural integrity along the main ramparts. Local teams are working to reinforce the breaches while the siege continues.

variants.headline: {{city}} holds against the siege
body: Hear me, {{terms.civic.people}} of {{city}}! The enemy is at the gate and the wall is battered, but it still stands! Bring water to the rampart and keep your fires low! Stand fast. The wall holds!

variants.headline: The Crumbling Walls of {{city}}
body: With the wall strength at {{wallStrength}}, much of {{city}}'s ramparts has been reduced to rubble. The {{owner.civic.government}} promised an impregnable defense, yet the city is now a sieve. If the {{owner.civic.leaderTitle}} does not break this siege immediately, there will be no city left to save.

variants.headline: BLOOD ON THE BRICKS
body: A guard in {{city}} leaned against a jagged wall and wept. He remembers when the ramparts were smooth and strong; now, there are more holes than stone. The enemy is too close.

variants.headline: Notice to the residents of {{city}}
body: The ramparts of {{city}} have sustained damage during the current siege. Be assured that {{terms.civic.government}} is directing all necessary repairs to ensure our safety and the continued strength of our defenses.

variants.headline: {{city}} blames pillage for unhappy citizens
body: Raiders stripped the land around {{city}} and left the farmsteads empty. In the city, pillage is the leading cause of unhappiness and accounts for {{pillagedPopulation}} {{terms.civic.people}}. Even after driving raiders away, {{owner.civic.government}} would need to send in worker teams to restore the order.

variants.headline: Pillage and Neglect in {{city}}
body: The unrest gripping {{city}} is a direct result of the {{owner.civic.government}}'s failure to protect its own land. {{pillagedPopulation}} people are now suffering because the military was nowhere to be found. Where were the patrols? Who should be responsible for the failure?

variants.headline: The road to {{city}} is empty now
body: The cart track south of {{city}} used to be busy before daybreak. Now the ruts are dry and the farms along it stand open to the wind, their doors gone for firewood. The families who worked them sleep inside the walls and walk out each morning to look at what is left.

variants.headline: Notice to the {{terms.civic.people}} of {{city}}
body: We are credibly informed that recent disturbances in the countryside have caused distress for {{pillagedPopulation}} {{terms.civic.people}}. Let us trust that a swift return to peace will soon restore the prosperity of {{city}} and its neighbors.

variants.headline: Destruction of {{city}} underway
body: The razing of {{city}} is currently in progress. Approximately {{population}} people remain in the area as the structures are brought down. The process will be finished in {{turns}}.

variants.headline: The Erasure of {{city}}
body: {{terms.civilization}} is systematically dismantling {{city}}, and the process will be complete in {{turns}}. While the loss of a population of {{population}} is a stark figure, the {{terms.civic.government}} views the site as a strategic burden. By clearing the land, we remove a drain on national resources and open the way for more efficient expansion.
variants.subheadline: A hard choice for the national good

variants.headline: A Final Prayer for {{city}}
body: At its height, {{city}} served as a bastion of the spirit, fostering a community of {{population}} believers. We recall the great festivals that once filled its squares with hymns of praise. This trial has come to pass, and as the walls fall over the next {{turns}}, we entrust its memory to the heavens.

variants.headline: CITY WIPED OFF MAP!
body: The {{terms.civic.government}} is erasing {{city}}, and the demolition will be done in {{turns}}. Around {{population}} people have been told their homes no longer exist. The streets are full of crates and crying children. The map is getting cleaner, but the people are getting nowhere.
variants.subheadline: Families cast out as walls come down
